name: My Guardian Angel
source:
Daisy is a troubled young woman starting a new leaf at university away from her hometown. She suddenly gets entangled with her bizarre, yet charming, roommate, Samyaza. 

A story about falling in love in college, a tale of desperate attempts to fill a void, a guide on how to become a brand new person, and something that probably happened to you, or someone you know, once. 

[From [url=https://heartonfiea.itch.io/my-guardian-angel]itch.io[/url]]
